name: EPIC 220263706
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 12.1 solar radii and 1.60 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,426 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.60 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,973 K at its surface.
